maddeler.e:
أنضرب (form VII)
# أَنْضَرِبُ (ʔanḍaribu) /ʔan.dˤa.ri.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْضَرَبَ (inḍaraba)
# أَنْضَرِبَ (ʔanḍariba) /ʔan.dˤa.ri.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْضَرَبَ (inḍaraba)
# أَنْضَرِبْ (ʔanḍarib) /ʔan.dˤa.rib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْضَرَبَ (inḍaraba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
